verdict.rationale: Jan ships its own OpenAI-compatible local API server, but the documented endpoints cover inference only: listing models, chat completions with streaming and tool calling, and Anthropic-style messages. The UI does much more, including Hub model download and import, custom assistant and project management, MCP tool approval and settings, and none of that is documented as exposed through the API. Missing for 10: API endpoints for model download/import/management, assistant and project CRUD, MCP configuration and tool approval, settings, an OpenAPI spec, and any documented UI-to-API parity commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Jan's local API server exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST API at http://127.0.0.1:1337.
Jan provides a built-in, OpenAI-compatible API server that runs entirely on your computer, powered by `llama.cpp`.
OpenAI-Compatible API: Local server at `localhost:1337` for other applications
